title: SIS Sync Failure — Halverson High School Nurse

callee.name: Marcus Delacroix
callee.label: Director of School Safety / District Emergency Manager

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: This is Nurse Amanda Reyes at Halverson High School. I just manually updated Chloe Mendez's attendance to 'present' in the paper log and the front office's attendance spreadsheet because she’s in the library for testing. But I just checked the SIS and it still shows her as absent. Is there a sync delay?

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: Understood, Amanda. We’re aware of system delays across multiple sites. Hold for a moment while I verify status with IT.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, sir. I’ll keep the paper log updated for now. Chloe’s in the library, 104, front office has her name on the attendance sheet.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the SIS is not updating in real time. The technical team must validate whether the delay is due to network load or a broader failure. Watch for Prin to initiate headcount using the 05:00 offline roster.
